title: Vesper and the Clock
author: Gideon Galloway
blurb: Sebastian Sterling, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ice breaks on the river.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
